question: Which sighted objects count as inauspicious omens at the outset?
premises: Sight itself functions as an omen indicator.
Clay vessels appear among ominous sights.
An oil vessel likewise appears among ominous sights.
inference: Encountering these objects by sight signals inauspiciousness.
uncertainties: The exact ritual context of the sighting is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: By sight, clay vessels and likewise an oil vessel are inauspicious omens.
